title.en: To the Tune Yumeiren: Listening to Rain

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: Song dynasty lyric (ci); the author died around 1301.
basis.zh: 宋词，作者约卒于 1301 年。

note.en: Jiang Jie lived through the end of the Song dynasty and spent his later years in retirement. In eight lines he gives a whole life as three rains: one heard in youth among singers, one heard while travelling, and one heard in old age in a temple. The last line is not despair; it is someone letting the rain be rain, all night.
note.zh: 蒋捷经历了宋朝的终结，晚年隐居不仕。短短八句，用三场雨写完一生：少年在歌楼上听雨，壮年在客舟中听雨，老年在僧庐下听雨。最后一句不是绝望，而是一个人任由雨就是雨，一直下到天亮。

excerpt.orig: 悲歡離合總無情，一任階前點滴到天明。
excerpt.en: Joy and grief, parting and meeting, have no feeling for us: / let the rain drip on the steps until the dawn.
excerpt.zh: 悲欢离合总无情，一任阶前点滴到天明。

gloss.en: A house where singing girls performed.
gloss.zh: 歌楼：歌女表演的楼阁，指寻欢作乐的地方。
罗帐：用轻软的丝织品做的床帐。

gloss.en: A goose that has lost its flock.
Flecked with white, like stars: greying hair.
gloss.zh: 星星：形容鬓发花白，像星星点点。

gloss.en: To let it be, to leave it to.

note.en: A whole life told as three rains in eight lines, youth, travel and old age, with an ending that lets the rain be rain; few lyrics are so perfectly structured.
note.zh: 八句写尽一生：少年、壮年、暮年三场雨，结尾任雨自落；结构如此完美的词并不多见。
